display.label: AWS ACM Certificate
display.description: Provision and validate public and private SSL/TLS certificates using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the ACM certificate. Serves as map key.

sections.label: Domain Configuration
sections.description: Primary domain name, alternative names, and key cryptography algorithm.

fields.label: Certificate Name
fields.description: Name identifier applied to the certificate as a Name tag.

validation.pattern_error: Name must contain only alphanumeric characters, dots, dashes, and underscores.

fields.label: Primary Domain Name
fields.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) for which the certificate is issued.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid domain name (e.g. example.com or *.example.com).

fields.label: Subject Alternative Names (SANs)
fields.description: List of additional domain names or wildcard domains to include in the certificate.

fields.label: Key Algorithm
fields.description: Cryptographic algorithm and key size for the certificate.

sections.label: Validation & Route 53
sections.description: Domain validation method and automated Route 53 DNS record generation.

fields.label: Validation Method
fields.description: Method to validate domain ownership (DNS recommended for automated renewals).

options.label: Email (Approval email sent to WHOIS contacts)

fields.label: Create Route 53 Records
fields.description: Automatically create DNS validation CNAME records in Amazon Route 53.

fields.label: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
fields.description: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID to create validation records in (e.g., Z1234567890ABCDEF).

fields.label: Wait for Validation
fields.description: Wait for certificate validation to complete before concluding Terraform deployment.

sections.label: Private Certificate Authority
sections.description: Optional integration with AWS Private Certificate Authority (ACM PCA).

fields.label: Private CA ARN
fields.description: The ARN of an AWS ACM Private CA to issue private enterprise certificates.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags assigned to the ACM certificate.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the certificate.
